cohort: Theoretical cohort of 110,000 pregnant women undergoing cesarean delivery and desiring permanent sterilization
finding: Bilateral tubal ligation and bilateral opportunistic salpingectomy at the time of cesarean delivery were both found to be cost-effective strategies for permanent sterilization and ovarian cancer risk reduction.
mod_finding: Both bilateral tubal ligation and bilateral opportunistic salpingectomy at the time of cesarean delivery were cost-effective for permanent sterilization and ovarian cancer risk reduction.
